decision.evidence: The bound applied scalar S_N to f although the Example and Proof 3.1 define S_N as a quadrature value. Removed the single (f); the current proof supplies the same lower bound for the scalar. Independently recomputed first-panel error h^(3/2)/6 and the C^2 later-panel bound h^(3/2)/(48*i^(3/2)). Concavity makes all excesses nonnegative; the finite reciprocal-power sum is <=3, including N=1,2. Thus e_N is between h^(3/2)/6 and 11*h^(3/2)/48. Substitution into (4e_(2N)-e_N)/3 gives (8sqrt(2)-11)/144>0; dividing by h^2 diverges. Smoothness is not asserted at zero. Confirmed and removed scalar application S_N(f); all proof mathematics is unchanged. Pre/post snapshot comparison: item bytes unchanged by reader; Alpha fixes the routed scalar notation.
